## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle Tang commentary on the *Sìfēnlǜ* 四分律 ([KR6k0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0001)) by **Huáisù** 懷素 ([懷素](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%87%B7%E7%B4%A0), 624–697), the founding master of the **Dōngtǎ** 東塔 ("Eastern Pagoda") *Sìfēn* school — the third of the three competing Tang Vinaya schools (alongside **Dàoxuān**'s *Nánshān* and **Fǎlì**'s *Xiāngbù*). *Kāizōng* 開宗 ("opening the school's tenets") signals the foundational doctrinal-systematic intent of the work.

**Abstract**

The *Kāizōng jì* is the principal surviving witness to the *Dōngtǎ* 東塔 *Sìfēnlǜ* tradition and the doctrinal counterpart to Huáisù's celebrated *karman* compilations [KR6k0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0047) *Sēng jiémó* and [KR6k0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0048) *Ní jiémó*. The work mounts a systematic attack on the *Nánshān* doctrinal positions of Dàoxuān ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)), particularly on the *jiètǐ* 戒體 ("substance of the precepts") question; it represents the *Yogācāra*-influenced reading of Vinaya that follows from Huáisù's earlier collaboration with **Xuánzàng** [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) on the *Yogācārabhūmi* translation. Although the *Dōngtǎ* school did not displace the *Nánshān* in the long run, the *Kāizōng jì* remained a landmark of Tang Vinaya scholarship and was studied in the Sòng-period *Lǜzōng* curriculum as the principal alternative voice to the *Nánshān* synthesis. Composition belongs to Huáisù's mature career (post-670, after his Vinaya specialisation under Dàoxuān).
